description: Marks this directory as CommonJS: pa11y-ci and Lighthouse CI require() their config files, and the repo root is an ES-module package. `devDependencies` is the single place the quality toolchain's versions are written — ./run.js reads them and hands them to npx, so `npm run a11y` locally and the Quality workflow on CI always run the same build. puppeteer is the exception: test/a11y/flows.test.mjs imports it rather than shelling out, so quality.yml installs this version into the root node_modules instead of running it through ./run.js.
